reason: A local PDF processing plugin that reads PDFs through the harness filesystem and extracts text, metadata, and selected page ranges with explicit resource limits.

summaries.zh: 通过 Harness 文件系统本地读取 PDF，提取文本、标题元数据、页数和指定页码范围。
summaries.en: Reads PDF files locally through the Harness filesystem to extract text, title metadata, page counts, and selected page ranges.

capabilities: Reads PDF files through the harness filesystem interface
Extracts PDF text, title metadata, page counts, and selected page ranges
Applies file-size, page-count, and output-character limits
